name: Visions
overview: Scripture reveals that visions are a divine means by which God communicates with His people, often appearing in dreams or in the night, as seen when God spoke to Jacob in visions of the night (Genesis 46:2) and made Himself known to prophets in visions and dreams (Numbers 12:6). These supernatural encounters can include appearances of angels or divine glory, such as the angel of the Lord appearing in the burning bush to Moses (Exodus 3:2-3). Visions are sometimes accompanied by a trance state, enabling the recipient to receive profound revelation, exemplified by the seer who saw the vision of the Almighty while falling into a trance (Numbers 24:16). Through these visions, God reassures, instructs, and reveals His will, as He did with Abram, promising protection and reward (Genesis 15:1).
